description:
Get one QA run you started: where the testing stands, what it cost, the report and its findings, and what each tester sent.
Use for: checking a QA run’s progress and reading its findings and each tester’s written account and evidence.
Not for: finding a run id (list_qa_runs); reading a taste run (get_taste_run); checking your wallet balance (get_wallet).
Money: US cents.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: get_qa_run({"runId":"qa_run_7Np3sD8"})
Errors: only the common ones; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

runId.description: The run id the create call or the list answered with.

name: get_qa_run

isTestersTruncated.description: True when the run has more testers than shown.

closedAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

completedAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

cost.description: Each amount is left out until the run has recorded it.

refunded.description: Given back to your wallet so far.

reserved.description: Set aside from your wallet for this run.

spent.description: Paid out of what was set aside so far.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

escalationCount.description: Decisions the platform passed to a person.

failureReason.description: Why the run is blocked or failed, as a short code such as insufficient_wallet_balance or period_cap_reached. Present only when the run is blocked or failed.

fundedAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

state.description: recovery_funding_needed: add funds to resume. review_unavailable: result review failed. state_error: testing state unreadable. Other values show testing progress.

report.description: Left out until the run has a report.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

isDegraded.description: True when the report was written from partial results.

supplements.description: Later findings from results accepted after the report.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

reportOutcome.description: Left out until the run has a report.

scheduledFor.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

spots.description: Testers holding a paid place, against the places paid for.

status.description: blocked_awaiting_funds: waiting for money in your wallet. collecting: testers are applying and testing. reviewing: results are being checked. completed_settling: done, pay is being settled. closed: done, see report. cancelling, cancelled, expired, failed: over without a full result. unknown: the stored state could not be read.

stop.description: Present once a stop was asked for.

completedAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

requestedAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

state.description: draining: no new testers, those working may finish. stopped: over.

testerCount.description: How many testers the run pays for.

submission.description: Left out until the tester sends a result.

submittedAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

verdict.description: The check of this tester’s result. Left out until checked.

title: Get a QA run
